title: Cover bounded-read admission and failed-wait production wiring
outcome: Ensure regressions detect bypassing production group-admission retention or failed-wait phase guards and retained Unknown propagation.
acceptance: A deterministic regression exercises the conversion, positive-group validation and retention wiring used by production, and fails when admission errors bypass unresolved-owner retention.

A deterministic adapter-level failed-wait regression verifies retained Unknown and rejection of subsequent nonzero signal/probe, with a successful-wait control, and fails if the adapter bypasses phase tracking.
